06-24-1335 is June 24, 1335.  
34 weeks = 34 × 7 = 238 days.  
Add 6 more days → total 244 days.  
June 24 + 244 days: June has 30 days, so June 24 → July 1 is 7 days, remaining 237 days.  
July 31 days, August 31, September 30, October 31, November 30, December 31, January 31, February 28 (1336 is a leap year? 1336 divisible by 4 → yes, leap year).  
Count days: July 31, Aug 31, Sep 30, Oct 31, Nov 30, Dec 31 → total 184 days from July 1 to Dec 31.  
237 - 184 = 53 days into 1336.  
Jan 31 days → 53 - 31 = 22 days into February.  
February 29 in 1336 (leap year) → Feb 22 is valid.  

FINAL_ANSWER: 1336-02-22
